programs.title: Getaway
programs.desc: This week on Getaway our cruise through Japan continues along the west coast tasting extraordinary seafood, visiting beautiful gardens and enjoying a variety of cultural experiences.

programs.title: Building Roots
programs.desc: A woman bought a downtown home to honour her late father, but it's a maze of awkward rooms that isn't suitable for family living. Ben and Cristi design an open concept living area with vaulted ceilings, flowing into an outdoor space.

programs.title: Masters Of Flip
programs.desc: Kortney and Dave take on the challenge of flipping a century classic. While Dave remains cautious about the risks that come with flipping an older home, Kortney sees its as an opportunity for great design potential.

programs.title: Fixer To Fabulous
programs.desc: A California couple moved their family of five to Arkansas, but the '90s rancher they purchased needs a major makeover before they can move in. Dave and Jenny look to transform the dated house into a California style dream home with a unique kids' space.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: Mika and Brian are called on to create a more compact and casual home for a woman starting a new chapter. Mika gets her old home ready to sell.

programs.title: Open Homes Australia
programs.desc: The team kicks off the season in the Northern NSW hinterland, we get an inside look at James Trebles own home on the Central coast and at the end of the episode, we see what could possibly be the best home we've seen in 9 seasons.
